name: CPAC Center for Legislative Accountability (formerly American Conservative Union ratings)
notes: 2025 congressional rating (percent of votes matching the conservative position) as 'score' and lifetime rating as 'lifetime', from the CPAC Center for Legislative Accountability (formerly American Conservative Union ratings). COVERAGE: 517 of 539 roster members. METHOD: 51 members came from the first server-rendered entries of the All Lawmakers list at cpac.org/us/ratings (url field = that list page); the other 466 were read one page at a time from the per-member pages https://www.cpac.org/bio/<bioguide id lowercase> (url field = that page), fetched in batches of about 12 with WebFetch. Each page's name and state were checked against the roster (chamber, state, last name) before storing; the 2025 value was taken only from a block labeled 2025. Values were model-extracted from the fetched page text, so spot check. GAPS (22 members not stored, none rated zero): no 2025 rating on the page, only a 2024 block: Brad Sherman S000344 (lifetime 7), Diana Harshbarger H001086 (lifetime 93); N/A for 2025 with lifetime shown: Brittany Pettersen P000620 (lifetime 1); N/A or blank for both ratings (nonvoting delegates and commissioner): Eleanor Holmes Norton N000147, Stacey Plaskett P000610, Amata Radewagen R000600, James Moylan M001219, Kimberlyn King-Hinds K000404, Pablo Jose Hernandez H001103; N/A for both (special election winners seated after the rating window): Jimmy Patronis P000622, Randy Fine F000484, James Walkinshaw W000831, Adelita Grijalva G000606, Matt Van Epps V000139; page returned a client error, no CPAC page (newest members): Christian Menefee M001245, Alan Armstrong A000383, Clay Fuller F000485, Analilia Mejia M001246, James Gallagher G000607, Darline Graham G000608, Everton Blair B001328, Aisha Wahab W000832. Some members seated mid-2025 or later show identical 2025 and lifetime values because they have only one year of ratings. ratings.conservative.org refused automated access (robots_disallowed) and was not used. Former members shown with 2024 ratings (Dan Bishop, Bob Good, Debbie Lesko, Earl Blumenauer, Jamaal Bowman, Cori Bush) are not in the roster.
